name: extension-host core + desktop 1.0.2
comment: This tree's headless host with this tree's desktop provider, release/schema 1.0.2, pointer and media beside window
layout, as its only bundled provider (`task conformance`). The desktop 1.0.1 profile
(core-desktop-window-layout-extension-host.json) stays as the record of the desktop provider that Koine 0.5.0
released, and the desktop 1.0.0 profile (core-desktop-extension-host.json) stays as it is, held by the
selection-aware host over the released desktop provider.
